    Jeff Harnar - I KNOW THINGS NOW: My Life in Sondheim’s Words

    7:00 PM · Birdland Jazz Club, Hell's Kitchen · $35.46 Algo especial

    Music Director: Jon WeberBass: Steve DoyleDrums: Ray MarchicaDirected by: Sondra Lee Jeff Harnar returns to Birdland with his BroadwayWorld Award-winning show, I Know Things Now: My Life in Sondheims Words, on Monday, November 9 at 7pm. Drawing from the words and music of Stephen Sondheim, Harnar creates a deeply personal self-portrait of the emotional landscape of an openly gay New Yorker. Joined by renowned jazz pianist and music director Jon Weber, with Steve Doyle on bass and Ray Marchica on drums, Harnar explores an eclectic collection of songs from Follies, Into the Woods, A Little Night Music, Road Show, Dick Tracy, Passion, Company and more. With a gender-bending fluidity, Harnar brings his own perspective to Sondheims work, including many songs originally introduced by women. The show received Stephen Sondheims personal endorsement and was recorded by PS Classics as a MAC Award-winning album. I Know Things Now was directed by Broadway legend Sondra Lee, who originated the role of Tiger Lily opposite Mary Martin in Peter Pan and Minnie Fay opposite Carol Channing in Hello, Dolly! This special encore performance is dedicated to Lees memory following her passing in February 2026. Ingenious singularly special. The New York Sun A thing of wonder, a show of powerful storytelling unforgettable, impeccable and completely original.

    Tedd Firth Big Band

    9:30 PM · Birdland Jazz Club, Hell's Kitchen · $35.46 Algo especial

    Tedd Firth's 50th Birthday Celebration! Special Guests TBA Tedd Firth grew up in Hudson Falls, NY. Raised in a musical family (parents Pam and Ted were both music teachers and performing musicians in the area, brother Patrick is also a musician), Tedd began playing the piano at an early age and started taking lessons when he was five. Tedd's jazz piano studies began as a teenager with Lee Shaw in Albany, NY. Following graduation from Hudson Falls High School in 1994, Tedd attended William Paterson University in Wayne, NJ, receiving a BM in jazz piano performance in 1998. He went on to receive an MM degree in jazz piano performance from the Manhattan School of Music in 2000. While in college, Tedd began laying the groundwork for his professional career as a musician. Over the last 20 years, Tedd has become one of the first-call pianists in the New York City area for performance and recording work in several styles. In particular, specializing as an accompanist for vocalists, he has appeared in concert many times with some of the brightest stars on Broadway and the biggest names in the jazz world including: Barbara Cook, Brian Stokes Mitchell, Maureen McGovern, Michael Feinstein, Marilyn Maye, Tom Wopat, Joshua Bell, Elaine Paige, Tony DeSare, Linda Lavin, Christine Ebersole, Lucie Arnaz, Lee Ann Womack, Faith Prince, John Schneider, Melissa Errico, Karen Akers, Mary Cleere Haran, Margaret Whiting, Carol Sloane and Jennifer Roberts. New York appearances include Carnegie Hall, Lincoln Center, the Blue Note, Birdland, the Iridium, the Algonquin, the Cafe Carlyle, and Feinstein's/54 Below. Numerous national appearances include a performance at the White House. Recent highlights include serving as musical director for the original cast reunion of Into The Woods at the Brooklyn Academy of Music, as well as for the Jazz and Popular Song concerts curated by Mr. Feinstein at Jazz at Lincoln Center. As an arranger/orchestrator, Tedd's work has been performed by most major American symphony orchestras as well as Bernadette Peters and Liza Minnelli. Television appearances include "The Today Show," "Live From Lincoln Center" and "All My Children."

    The Cabaret Burlesque presents: Code Red

    9:00 PM · Berlin, East Village · $42.71 · ↻ Every Monday Para salir

    TCB presents: CODE RED Industry Night Weekly on Monday Doors 8pm Guest Opening Acts 8pm Main Show featuring The Cabaret Burlesque 9-10:30 Music and Bar until 12 am Contact @thecabaretburlesque on instagram to APPLY to perform as an Opening Act An Industry Night where your wildest fantasies just might come true. Welcome to CODE RED---an electrifying world where Parisian cabaret meets Amsterdam's edge, Moscow's mystique, and the unapologetic glamour of Studio 54. Fashion is as much a part of the performance as the artists themselves, with striking couture, bold silhouettes, and runway-worthy style setting the scene for an unforgettable night. Expect dazzling performances, intoxicating music, provocative artistry, and immersive moments that blur the line between audience and spectacle. Inspired by the golden age of nightlife, where icons, artists, and dreamers came to see and be seen, CODE RED celebrates fearless self-expression, decadent entertainment, and the thrill of the unexpected. Dress boldly. Stay curious. Bring your calling card. Welcome to the show where fantasy, fashion, and nightlife collide.
